notes.title: [Language Setting Bug Fixed]
notes.content: [p]We have fixed an issue where the language setting was not being applied correctly.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "Dear Mirror Flower" Available Now!
notes.content: [p]A Japanese-style fantasy adventure by Kogado Studio.[/p][p]Step into a tranquil world and discover the story with your own eyes.[/p]

notes.title: Released the demo version 1.0.2
notes.content: [p]Fixed several translation errors in the English text.[/p][p]Resolved an issue where the game could become unstable depending on the Windows language settings.[/p]

notes.title: "Dear Mirror Flower" FREE TRIAL
notes.content: In this trial version, you can enjoy the beginning of the story for free. What’s more, your save data can be carried over to the full version. Ahead of the full release on June 20, don’t miss this chance to experience the world of "Dear Mirror Flower" That Will Eventually Scatter.
